title: Lattice: Generative Guardrails for Conversational Agents
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The evaluation focuses on general conversational safety, specifically detecting 'harmful' versus 'benign' dialogues based on the ProsocialDialog dataset.
findings: Not applicable. The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a subject of the study.
